description: Insufficient Role Segregation in Cognito User Pool While IAM roles for authenticated and admin users are defined, the current implementation lacks Cognito Identity Pools and proper group-to-role mapping, potentially allowing users to assume incorrect roles. A regular user might manipulate their token claims or exploit misconfigured role assumption policies to gain admin privileges.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1550 - Use Alternate Authentication Material
recommendation: Implement Cognito Identity Pools with proper group-to-role mapping
recommendation: Enhance API Gateway authorization checks

description: Insecure CORS Configuration in API Gateway and S3 Overly permissive CORS policies allow any origin to make requests to the API and S3 bucket, potentially exposing sensitive data or enabling unauthorized modifications. An attacker hosts a malicious website that makes authenticated requests to the API or S3 bucket using stolen credentials, exploiting the permissive CORS policy.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
recommendation: Restrict CORS policies to specific origins

description: Workflow Processing System Availability Risk Lambda functions have execution time limits and memory constraints that may be insufficient for processing large media files, leading to timeouts and failed operations. An attacker could upload extremely large or malformed media files to overwhelm the workflow processor and cause service disruption.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1499 - Endpoint Denial of Service
recommendation: Migrate workflow processor to container-based solution
recommendation: Implement file validation and chunking

description: Insufficient Monitoring and Logging of AI/ML Service Usage The operator Lambda has broad permissions to AI/ML services ('*' actions) and lacks detailed audit logging of service usage and data processing activities. An attacker gaining access to the operator Lambda could abuse AI/ML services to process unauthorized data or extract sensitive information without detection.
references: mitreATT&CK: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
mitreATT&CK: T1213 - Data from Information Repositories
owaspTop10: A09:2021-Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
recommendation: Implement least privilege access for AI/ML services

description: Insecure OpenSearch Domain Configuration The OpenSearch domain is configured with basic master user authentication and is not deployed within a VPC, potentially exposing it to unauthorized access. An attacker could attempt to brute force the master user credentials or exploit network exposure to gain unauthorized access to analytics data.
references: recommendation: Deploy OpenSearch within a VPC
